disposition_reason: Primary text reports Pb, Cd, Hg and As in Forastero cocoa beans from four stated origins (Table 1) and Al in cocoa bean kernels and shells (Table 2), each as mean ± SD of triplicate determinations; all rows are in-scope cocoa materials.

study.design: market/raw-material survey (one lot per origin) with an oxidative-stability trial
study.material_scope: Forastero cocoa beans (whole beans for Pb/Cd/Hg/As); kernels and shells separately for Al
study.growing_origin_vs_market: Beans 'purchased from Cameroon, Ecuador, Nigeria and Ghana' (read as growing origins); buyer location not stated (authors at Latvia University of Agriculture, analyses at BIOR institute, Latvia).
study.sampling_unit: one 200 g mixed sample per origin drawn from 10 bags of 60 kg (10% of the batch), analysed in triplicate; whether 10 bags applies per origin is not explicit
study.method: Hg by ISO 6637-1984(E); As, Pb, Cd by AOAC 986.15; Se, Zn, Al by AOAC 986.15 (instrumental technique not named)
study.lod_loq: Hg and As: 'method allows determination of value starting from 0.01 mg/kg' (Table 1 footnote) yet As reported as < 0.06 mg/kg; Se: 0.1 mg/kg (Table 2 footnote). Pb, Cd, Al LOD not stated.

findings.basis: not stated (whole-bean basis; dry vs fresh not reported)
findings.notes: One mixed 200 g sample per origin analysed in triplicate (n=3 replicates); mean ± SD of analytical replicates, not between-lot variation. Forastero beans. Superscript letters = ANOVA groupings.

findings.basis: not stated (whole-bean basis; dry vs fresh not reported)

contradictions_with_stored_summary: Summary says beans were 'sampled from 10 bags per origin'; primary text says beans were selected from 10 bags of 60 kg (10% of the batch) without stating that this applies per origin.
Summary implies a dry vs whole-bean basis is known; primary text does not state the analytical basis.
Summary sample_n 4 'lots'; primary text supports one mixed sample per origin with n=3 analytical replicates, i.e. replicate SDs are not between-lot variability.
unresolved: Analytical basis (dry weight vs as received) not reported.
Whether Table 1 Pb/Cd/Hg/As values are whole beans (abstract says 'whole cocoa beans') while Table 2 splits kernels/shells; Table 1 not stated to be kernels.
As reporting limit < 0.06 mg/kg conflicts with the footnote stating determination from 0.01 mg/kg.
Collection/purchase dates not reported; beans described as having 'a shelf life of around four months'.
Instrumental technique for AOAC 986.15 not specified; no QA/CRM information.
Text ranges (Cd 0.017-0.2, Pb 0.32-0.52 mg/kg) are ranges of origin means, not extracted as separate findings.
